note: v506: Each line on an invoice can now have its own date. Every item used to print the invoice's date, so a job done over several days looked like it all happened at once. There's a Date field on each line item (and on each customer expense) — leave it blank and it uses the invoice date exactly like before, so nothing you've already billed changes. Billing time entries now puts each punch's day in its own date column instead of tacking it onto the description.
